ReTzar, a fan remake of Tzar.

Run ReTzar.exe. The first time, choose the folder where Tzar is installed.

Windows may say that it protected your PC, since the game isn't signed:
click "More info", then "Run anyway".

https://github.com/ColCarlo/ReTzar
Code: GPL-3.0-or-later (see LICENSE.txt). Tzar and all its game data are
(c) and (tm) Haemimont Games, Take-Two Interactive and FX Interactive.
An unofficial fan project.
